table.retrieve:
SELECT
	Doctype = 'PV-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(dbo.purledger.PURINVCODE, 10))), 
	Type='P', 
	itemname 	= dbo.item.name, 
	aliasname 	= dbo.item.customicode,
	icode = dbo.item.icode,
	date 		= dbo.purledger.date,	
	PurchaseCategory = CASE WHEN dbo.purledger.PurCatCode <=2 THEN 'P' ELSE 'L' END,
	purinvcode = dbo.purledger.purinvcode,
	suppinvcode= dbo.purledger.suppinvcode, 		
	supplier 	= dbo.accounts.name,
	packing    = dbo.item.packingdesc,
	Batch 	 	= dbo.purdetail.batch,	
	Expiry	 	= dbo.purdetail.expiry,
	rate       = dbo.purdetail.purprice, 
	discperc	= dbo.purdetail.discperc,
	unitsalestax = dbo.purdetail.unitsalestax,
	gstperc    = dbo.purdetail.gstperc,
	ItemDisc	= ((dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty) * dbo.purdetail.purprice) * (dbo.purdetail.discperc * .01),
	qty 		 	= dbo.purdetail.looseqty + dbo.purdetail.packqty,
	bonus		= dbo.purdetail.bonusqty
FROM
	dbo.purledger, 
	dbo.purdetail,
	dbo.item,    
	dbo.accounts
WHERE
	:ai_allitems = 0 AND
	dbo.purledger.date BETWEEN :ad_StartDate and :ad_EndDate  and
	dbo.purledger.purinvcode = dbo.purdetail.purinvcode and  
	dbo.purledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and  
	dbo.purdetail.icode IN (:al_icode) AND
	dbo.purdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode
UNION ALL
 SELECT
	Doctype = 'PR-' + LTRIM(RTRIM(STR(dbo.prledger.PRINVCODE, 10))), 
	Type='R',
	itemname 	= dbo.item.name, 
	aliasname 	= dbo.item.customicode,
	icode = dbo.item.icode,
	date 		= dbo.prledger.date,	
	PurchaseCategory = 'L',
	purinvcode = dbo.prledger.prinvcode,
	suppinvcode= NULL, 		
	supplier 	= dbo.accounts.name,
	packing    = dbo.item.packingdesc,
	Batch 	 	= dbo.prdetail.batch,	
	Expiry	 	= dbo.prdetail.expiry,
	rate       = dbo.prdetail.prprice, 
	discperc	= dbo.prdetail.discperc,
	unitsalestax = dbo.prdetail.unitsalestax,
	gstperc    = dbo.prdetail.gstperc,
	ItemDisc	= ((dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty) * dbo.prdetail.prprice) * (dbo.prdetail.discperc * .01),
	qty 		 = -(dbo.prdetail.looseqty + dbo.prdetail.packqty),
	bonus		=  - dbo.prdetail.bonusqty
FROM

WHERE

	dbo.prledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode and

objects.name: t_12
objects.text: Item wise Purchase and Return Activity

objects.name: compute_8
objects.expression: Round(sum (if( type ='P',1, -1) * Round ( ( qty + bonus ) * unitsalestax + Round ( c_netamount * gstperc * 0.01, 2 ) , 2) for all) , 0)

objects.name: compute_15
objects.expression: Round(sum(if(type='P', ( qty  *  rate ) -  itemdisc, ( qty  *  rate ) + itemdisc )  for all), 0)

objects.name: c_salestaxvalue
objects.expression: Round ( ( qty + bonus ) * unitsalestax + Round ( c_netamount * gstperc * 0.01, 2 ) , 2)

objects.name: c_netamount
objects.expression: if(type='P', ( qty  *  rate ) -  itemdisc, ( qty  *  rate ) + itemdisc )

objects.name: c_totalsalestax
objects.expression: Round(sum (if( type ='P',1, -1) * Round ( ( qty + bonus ) * unitsalestax + Round ( c_netamount * gstperc * 0.01, 2 ) , 2) for group 1) , 0)

objects.name: c_totalamount
objects.expression: Round(sum(if(type='P', ( qty  *  rate ) -  itemdisc, ( qty  *  rate ) + itemdisc )  for group 1), 0)
